items.stem: Which TWO actions strengthen ethical due diligence beyond tier-1 suppliers?

options.text: Mapping sub-tier suppliers and their locations
options.rationale: Correct: visibility into lower tiers is essential for genuine due diligence.

options.text: Requiring cascaded codes of conduct down the chain
options.rationale: Correct: cascading standards to sub-tiers extends ethical control.

options.text: Checking only the tier-1 supplier's annual accounts
options.rationale: Accounts alone do not reveal sub-tier labour risks.

options.text: Relying on the lowest quoted price as a proxy for compliance
options.rationale: Low price is unrelated to ethical compliance and may increase risk.

items.explanation: Correct: visibility into lower tiers is essential for genuine due diligence.
